args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged: none.
Cleared: r01–r08. All three final checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) passed on every run. No remedies were kept, no roll-backs happened, and the width-free ratio was not used.
Batch outliers: none. r01 and r08 have |z| = 3.19 only because the batch MAD is 0. The real differences are tiny: centre REGR peak 53.02 vs 53.01 %/h, growth zone 684 vs 695 µm, and largest flank difference −6.41 vs −6.50 %/h. The peak and the largest flank difference are at the same position as the median, 421 µm from the tip.
Common pattern among flagged runs: none.
